data: What is the value of micro-F1 for the green line in the second plot when the value of P is 64?

The question asks for the value of micro-F1 for the green line in the second plot when the value of P is 64. From the caption, we know that the second plot corresponds to the parameter P in Document-Class Alignment. The green line represents the X-Class-Align model. 

Looking at the second plot, the green line intersects the y-axis at approximately 85 when the value of P is 64. Therefore, the value of micro-F1 for the green line in the second plot when the value of P is 64 is around 85.
